paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut Jeremiah, remez 306.[^1]

notes.text: The heading abbreviates Abba's title, retained as R'. The locator רמז שו is decoded as remez 306, without verifying an edition or its numbering. The final period remains in the Hebrew; the earlier candidate's speculative folio-side interpretation is not adopted for this remez locator.
